Patients with co-existent osteoarthritis or arthropathy responded less well to pamidronate in terms of pain perception, than those patients without joint disease.4 While hearing loss may or may not im- prove with pamidronate,5,6 there has been a report of successful treatment of optic neuropathy due to Paget’s disease with pamid- ronate and dexamethasone.7 Bisphosphonates have also been given in other bone diseases with a similar pathology, particular- ly increased osteoclastic resorption. For example, pamidronate has had beneficial effects in patients with fibrous dysplasia of bone, a rare congenital disease leading to osteolytic lesions.8-10 1. Selby PL.
